data.description: A phycomid attacks by firing a glob of acid from one of its several mushroom-like stalks.  This attack has a range increment of 10 feet.  A phycomid can fire up to six acid pellets per minute - during rounds in which the fungus has no acid pellets, it has no method of attacking at all and must wait until its acid stores replenish in 4 rounds before continuing a battle.
data.name: Acid Pellet
